description: This file defines a SearchToolRegistry class for managing search tool configurations in a database, including methods for adding, deleting, updating, and retrieving search tools, with internal utility functions for data conversion and database interactions.

classes.name: SearchToolRegistry
classes.description: A class for managing search tool configurations in a database, including CRUD operations and data conversion utilities.

methods.name: _convert_prisma_to_dict
methods.description: Converts a Prisma model object to a dictionary with ISO formatted datetime strings.

methods.name: add_search_tool_to_db
methods.description: Adds a new search tool configuration to the database.

methods.name: delete_search_tool_from_db
methods.description: Deletes a search tool from the database by its ID.

methods.name: update_search_tool_in_db
methods.description: Updates an existing search tool configuration in the database.

methods.name: get_all_search_tools_from_db
methods.description: Retrieves all search tools from the database.

methods.name: get_search_tool_by_id_from_db
methods.description: Retrieves a search tool by its ID.

methods.name: get_search_tool_by_name_from_db
methods.description: Retrieves a search tool by its name.
